propositions: The deprecated env var REBAR_LLM_MODEL must be removed from the resolver and all resolver logic, retaining only a fail-loud tombstone check in LLMConfig.from_env that raises RemovedInputError if the env is still set.

The config key [tool.rebar.llm].model and all surviving model resolution rungs (CLI override via -c, per-class env REBAR_LLM_<CLASS>_MODEL, config table, per-step workflow model: override) must continue to work without the env channel.
All 15 test files that currently set REBAR_LLM_MODEL and build LLMConfig must be retargeted to use surviving config channels to avoid raising RemovedInputError.

All prose sites naming the env var as live (src/rebar/llm/config.py, src/rebar/llm/completion.py, src/rebar/llm/gate_context.py) and operator-facing docs (runbooks, compose file) must be reworded to past tense or removed.

The deprecation row must be deleted from _deprecations.py with the removal recorded in the historical NOTE, and a new tombstone row matching REBAR_LLM_MAX_ITERS precedent (behavior='error') must be added with operator-approval date 2026-08-12.

Automated env registry docs (docs/env-vars.md) must be regenerated, and all manual docs (config.md, llm-framework.md, llm-example-configs.md, local-dev-env.md, ci-provider-matrix.md, plan-review-gate.md, workflow-authoring-v2.md) must be updated to reflect the removal.
